issues.description: The Bookstore implementation declares its books storage as a private property, but Client.main accesses bookstore.books. This visibility mismatch causes a compilation error and prevents students from using the Bookstore as shown in the example client code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the books property accessible to clients. For example, remove the 'private' modifier so it is internally visible (let books: [Book]), or provide a public/internal read-only accessor (e.g. public var booksList: [Book] { return books }) or make the property 'internal'/'public' depending on the intended visibility. Ensure the chosen visibility matches the problem statement's expectations.
